name: Button Group
description: An attached cluster of related actions with hairline seams and shared corner radius.

anatomy.description: Two to four sibling Buttons rendered flush against each other.
Hairline borders between buttons that replace the usual gap.
Only the first and last buttons keep their outer corner rounding.

dos: Use for closely related options of equal weight, like Day / Week / Month.
Keep labels to one word so the cluster stays compact.
Switch to the vertical orientation in narrow side panels.
donts: Don't mix variants inside a group; the cluster reads as one control.
Don't group unrelated actions just to save space.
Don't exceed four buttons; use a Menu for larger sets.

examples.title: Attached actions
examples.description: Buttons butt together with shared seams; vertical stacks work too.

examples.title: Vertical cluster
examples.description: Use vertical orientation when the actions stack in a narrow panel.

guidance.useWhen: Two to four tightly related actions belong to one decision.
guidance.avoidWhen: The actions are unrelated or need distinct visual priority; space them normally.
guidance.behavior: Seams collapse to hairlines and only the outer corners keep their radius.
guidance.responsive: Let the cluster wrap or switch to vertical orientation on narrow screens.

notes: Each button in the group keeps its own focus stop and accessible name; the group itself adds no keyboard behavior.
Buttons butt together visually but remain separate controls, so screen readers announce each action individually.
Disabled buttons keep their native semantics and are skipped in the tab order.

apiEntries.description:
Attaches sibling buttons into a single cluster: inner corners are squared
off and adjacent borders collapse into hairline seams.

props.description: Stack direction of the attached buttons.
props.name: orientation
